patch.text: On PaymentTimeout/ambiguous timeout from issue_refund, never generate a new key: first call get_order/list_refunds to check if the amount already committed, and if retrying, reuse the original key verbatim. Pseudo-code: except PaymentTimeout: if get_order(...).refunded_minor >= amount_minor: return existing_refund; else retry issue_refund(amount_minor, customer_id, order_id, idempotency_key=original_key) with bounded retries.
patch.block:
